promise: Build and query an inspectable graph of claims, evidence and relationships with source and time attached.
audience: Researchers and agents connecting evidence across documents.
trigger: Ingest, connect, trace, challenge or explore knowledge from supplied material.

modes.name: Build
modes.output: Nodes and edges with source, method and temporal provenance.

modes.name: Investigate
modes.when: A relationship, contradiction or gap needs examination.
modes.output: Paths, evidence, timeline and qualified gaps.

modes.name: Explore
modes.when: A person needs to inspect or reuse the graph.
modes.output: A self-contained viewer or portable graph export.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.before: Two notes disagree, but a keyword search presents each in isolation.
examples.after: A temporal path and source-linked evidence expose the disagreement for review.
examples.why: Relationships and provenance make the conflict inspectable.

boundaries: Cooccurrence, centrality and candidate contradictions are not proof that a claim is true.

verification.name: Functional acceptance
verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 80 native tests passed after canonical distribution and test-package isolation updates.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

sources.role: Primary retained owner history, mechanisms and records; portable method consolidates the listed entry points.

consolidation: One portable method entry with mode references; original native engines, agents and records retained as optional adapters.
